entry.note: 真实增量在于Uber优惠可能如何落到既有酒店围栏价及谁承担折扣。Expedia 26Q2 earnings release/transcript已公开B2B增速、分部经济性、技术与伙伴黏性、B2B地域结构，并对Uber仅表示不评论单一伙伴且其对指引不重大；公开材料未披露该折扣的出资方和合同费率机制。
entry.quote:
Uber will work through Expedia, not through the hotels. My high suspicion is that is funded by the hotels already. I'll tell you how it works and
then I'll tell you why I think this is true. Basically, what you do when you contract with a hotel is you contract different rate types. You have a
consumer-facing rate and then you have fenced rates which are for loyalty programs or mobile only or package rates or in the last week
kind of booking window. You get these different types of rates, and they are ring-fenced. In theory, this is a ring-fenced rate. It's a loyalty rate
within an Uber ecosystem. Why I think it's true is the number of hotels that are at that rate and I won't tell you why it looks very familiar to
me.
